verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway/MCP evidence is framed almost entirely around governance, security, observability, and auto-generating MCP servers from APIs (i.e., Kong as an MCP provider/gateway), not around Kong itself consuming external MCP servers' tools. The only hint of client-side MCP consumption is a single line under Insomnia's AI features noting 'MCP Servers and Clients, which connect to external AI-ready tools and resources,' which is thin and not elaborated with setup/usage details. missing for 10: first-party docs showing Kong (or Insomnia) actually configuring/using an external MCP server's tools, a walkthrough of adding an MCP server as a client, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this client capability.
